newsitem.title: GREECE: TURKISH TRUCK STORMS THROUGH GREEK BORDER POST.
newsitem.headline: TURKISH TRUCK STORMS THROUGH GREEK BORDER POST.

text.p: A truck with two Turkish soldiers and a civilian stormed through the northern Greek Evros border post on Monday and were arrested after an hour's chase, police said.

"The soldiers said they did not want to serve in the Turkish army. They did not stop at the the border checkpoint and we don't know how they got through the Turkish authorities," a police spkesman said.
He said the three men will be charged with illegal entry in Greek territory later in the day.
